subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 12,000.00 deposited at compound interest becomes double at the end of 5 years. At the end of 15 years the sum will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.12000 

Time = 5 years 

**Formulas used:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)⁵

⇒ 24000 = 12000 × (1 + r/100)5

⇒ 24000/12000 = (1 + r/100)5

⇒ 2 = (1 + r/100)5 (1) 

⇒ At the end of 15 years, 

⇒ Amount = 12000 × (1 + r/100)¹⁵

⇒ Amount = 12000 × [(1 + r/100)⁵ ]³ (From 1) 

⇒12000 × 2³

⇒12000 × 8 

⇒ 96000 

**∴ The amount at the end of 15 years will be Rs.96000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f8e66d87cde50ccf3349a5a1cdbbf8390e6a609c7ef02c4480a83969b5d64cc.png] 

**∴ The amount at the end of 15 years will be 8 times of 12000 = Rs.96000**
